name: Netherlands

pet.recycling_rate: SOURCE: plastic packaging recycled in the Netherlands: 49.1% in 2023 and 48.6% in 2024 (Eurostat env_waspacr, rates for the 2025 target, table updated 10 November 2026); all plastics together, no separate figure for PET bottles

steel.recycling_rate: SOURCE: steel packaging recycled in the Netherlands: 95% in 2023 and 97.2% in 2024 (Eurostat env_waspacr, rates for the 2025 target, table updated 10 November 2026); reported mean 96.1%, cut at 95%

pet.incineration_share: SOURCE: municipal waste in the Netherlands in 2024: 3450 kt incinerated with or without energy recovery and 124 kt landfilled, so 97% of what is not recycled is incinerated (Eurostat env_wasmun, table updated 15 October 2026); prior centred at 95%
